name: Quivering Quiver

effects.name: Arrow Spitting
effects.tooltip: Arrow Spitting : While this item is equipped and an enemy hits you, there is a chance that this item will produce a stack of 20 arrows of a random type. Where exactly the arrows come from remains a mystery.

flavor_text: This quiver is completely organic, and is rough and slimy to the touch. It shivers periodically, and when provoked it will sometimes disgorge arrows of a random type. Try not to think about where they've been. The quiver will also hold 10 different types of arrow or bolt and can store each type in a stack of up to 300. Total capacity: 3000.
notes: Randomly produces stacks of 20 arrows (never bolts) of the following if you are hit: +1 Xoriat Lawbane Arrows - Lawful Outsider Bane , ML:2 +3 Xoriat Arrows - ML:4 +3 Xoriat Cold Iron Arrows - ML:4 +3 Xoriat Adamantine Arrows - ML:4 +3 Xoriat Silver Arrows - ML:4 +3 Xoriat Corrosive Arrows - Acid , ML:6 +3 Xoriat Flaming Arrows - ML:6 +3 Xoriat Frost Arrows - ML:6 +3 Xoriat Shock Arrows - ML:6 +3 Xoriat Anarchic Arrows - ML:8
